text: Patriots rule out A.J. Brown, TreVeyon Henderson vs. Dolphins. Patriots wide receiver A.J. Brown has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Dolphins. In addition, No. 2 running back TreVeyon Henderson has been ruled out due to an illness.

author: ESPN
text: Records show 3 other women accused Packers' Josh Jacobs of abuse after arrest. Three other women contacted police to detail allegations of abuse against Packers RB Josh Jacobs following his May arrest for an altercation with his then-girlfriend.

author: Adam Schefter

author: Pete Thamel
text: NFL scouts favor Drew Mestemaker as first QB taken in draft. In a midseason poll of 25 NFL scouts, Oklahoma State's Drew Mestemaker was the overwhelming choice to be the first quarterback selected in the 2027 NFL draft.

author: John Keim
text: Source: Commanders DT Daron Payne suffered season-ending foot injury. Commanders defensive tackle Daron Payne suffered a season-ending Jones fracture in practice Friday, a source told ESPN's Adam Schefter.

author: Adam Schefter and Ian Rapoport

author: ESPN
text: Appellate court revives 'Sunday Ticket' antitrust verdict against NFL. A verdict in a class action lawsuit filed by "Sunday Ticket" subscribers claiming the NFL broke antitrust laws has been revived by a federal appeals court, more than two years after a $4.7 billion ruling against the league was reversed.

author: Ian Rapoport
text: Sources: Packers, Micah Parsons target return for Thanksgiving Eve game vs. Rams. The Packers and Micah Parsons are targeting the Thanksgiving Eve game against the Rams for his return to the field, sources told NFL Network.

author: Adam Schefter
text: 'No way' that Jets trade star WR Garrett Wilson before deadline, source says. The Jets are not expected to trade Garrett Wilson, sources told ESPN, despite increased speculation about the star wide receiver's future.

author: Adam Schefter
text: The Indianapolis Colts now are open to trading star running back Jonathan Taylor, sources told @RapSheet and me. Multiple teams have reached out to Indianapolis, and those talks are said to be active and ongoing.
